executiveSummary: Key developments include Apple's push into new markets, AI and ML advancements, and hardware releases, while Walmart and Google make significant strides in payments and search. Meanwhile, Tesla faces recalls and the EU cracks down on Apple's tax practices.

takeaways.title: AI/ML developments
takeaways.description: Major YouTube creators are facing backlash for accepting AI money, highlighting concerns over platform Higgsfield's capabilities

takeaways.title: Hardware releases
takeaways.description: Apple is set to release iPhone 18 Pro and Ultra, with camera-equipped AirPods and an M5 Pro MacBook Pro at discounted prices

takeaways.title: Industry shifts
takeaways.description: Walmart is finally rolling out Apple Pay support, and Google's Pixel 10A is available at a discount

worthWatching: Tesla recalls 3 million cars as part of China-wide push to stop hidden door handles
Apple paid $17 billion in taxes to Ireland last year
engineeringPerspective: The development of AI-powered camera capabilities in Apple's new iPhone models has significant implications for mobile photography and computer vision
The recent launch of the M5 Pro MacBook Pro offers engineers a new platform to explore the capabilities of Apple's M-series processors
